These are the artifacts published for KiCI **v0.24.0**. Pin by digest to
verify you are running exactly the bits we shipped — a registry that serves
substituted content fails a digest pull.

## Container images

| Image | Digest-pinned reference |
|-------|-------------------------|
| `kici-orchestrator` | `quay.io/kici-dev/kici-orchestrator:0.24.0@sha256:62f2aed362488f4cad9c08608ff97c0a6ff7b5c5e7e5de329189ed5e5154bfeb` |
| `kici-agent` | `quay.io/kici-dev/kici-agent:0.24.0@sha256:e10a5006a16c06446a9d0c2846c23edbdb9c44a3fbfb621189331cb9f83331b5` |

The digest is the multi-arch **manifest-list (image-index)** digest, so the same
reference resolves the correct image on both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.

### Verify before you run

A digest pull fails closed if the registry serves substituted content:

```bash
podman pull quay.io/kici-dev/kici-orchestrator:0.24.0@sha256:62f2aed362488f4cad9c08608ff97c0a6ff7b5c5e7e5de329189ed5e5154bfeb
```

KiCI tarballs do not carry npm-registry provenance attestations: npm mints
those from a supported CI provider's OIDC identity, and `pnpm release:prod`
runs interactively from an operator workstation. The integrity hashes above and
the container manifest digests are the verification path.

## Standalone packages

The [v0.24.0 GitHub release](https://github.com/kici-dev/kici-public/releases/tag/v0.24.0) carries a standalone
package of each component, full and light, for each platform, and a
`SHA256SUMS` file with the checksum of each package. A full package
includes Node.js and npm. A light package runs on a cached Node.js. The release
notes name the Node.js version. The [KiCI packaging guide](sea-binaries.md)
describes the packages.

- Components: `kici-orchestrator`, `kici-orchestrator-standalone`, `kici-admin`, `kici-agent`
- Platforms: `linux-x64`, `linux-arm64`, `darwin-x64`, `darwin-arm64`, `win-x64`, `win-arm64`

A package name has the form `<component>-0.24.0-<platform>[-light].<tar.gz|zip>`.
Download a package and `SHA256SUMS`, then verify the package before you extract it:

```bash
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/kici-dev/kici-public/releases/download/v0.24.0/kici-agent-0.24.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/kici-dev/kici-public/releases/download/v0.24.0/SHA256SUMS
grep " kici-agent-0.24.0-linux-x64.tar.gz$" SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -
```

On macOS, use `shasum -a 256 -c -` in place of `sha256sum -c -`.
